## Description

Compresses multi-tenor Treasury yield curves into low-dimensional non-linear latent manifolds using Variational Autoencoders to identify mispriced yield curve anomalies.

## Where it may fit

Central bank policy shifts, yield curve inversion/steepening transitions, fixed income relative value dislocations.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Funds, Global Macro Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Multi-tenor interest rate swap rates, sovereign bond yield curves, inflation expectation curves.

## Caveats

Latent space interpretations require regularization to avoid non-physical yield curve transformations.
